description: The pinned grammar sources the native grammars import. Each entry is one upstream grammar at one release: the vendored bytes (gzipped, hashed before compression), the repository and revision they come from, the license, the native grammar the import pipeline (js/scripts/import-native-grammars.mjs) produces from it, and the upstream test corpus at the same revision (gzipped JSON of each corpus file, hashed before compression) the native grammar is checked on against the oracle.
